name: Sojitz Corporation
summary: Sojitz Corporation operates as a general trading company worldwide. It is involved in the trading of completed automobiles; assembly and wholesales operations; retail sales operations; quality inspection operations; financing; sale of commercial aircraft, defense and related equipment, and business jets; transportation infrastructure projects; convenience store business; food service business; shopping center management; and real estate development.
